moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Next keeps these choices for Apply. Nothing is changed yet.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 下一步会保留这些选择供应用。尚未更改任何内容。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No active alert rule was processed. If the rule is paused, resume it before evaluating.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 没有处理任何有效的告警规则。若规则已暂停，请先继续再评估。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No alert rules explicitly reference this item yet. Add it from an alert rule's Shared item selector.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 还没有告警规则显式引用此项。请从告警规则的共享项选择器中添加。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No alert rules yet. Create a rule to evaluate a query and track its state.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 还没有告警规则。创建一条规则来评估查询并跟踪其状态。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No conflicts: no local node's record claims an item of this server's own.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 无冲突：没有本地节点的记录认领此服务器自己的项目。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No contact points have been added here.
No dashboard playlists yet. Create one to rotate through dashboards in a chosen order.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 还没有仪表板播放列表。创建一个，以便按所选顺序轮播仪表板。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No dashboards are available. Create a dashboard in the library before creating a playlist.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 没有可用的仪表板。创建播放列表之前，请先在库中创建一个仪表板。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No dashboards or reports are available to preview.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 没有可预览的仪表板或报表。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No Data Document specified, not exporting anything.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 未指定数据文档，不导出任何内容。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No dataset is available to you yet.
No deployment history: no component has been loaded, deployed or removed from this screen. The components the server started with run as usual; the Overview lists them.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 没有部署历史：此屏幕尚未加载、部署或移除任何组件。服务器启动时的组件照常运行；概览会列出它们。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No end time is recorded. The run may still be active or may have stopped before recording completion.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 没有记录结束时间。运行可能仍在进行，或在记录完成前已停止。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No error flag was recorded. Inspect the results and any errors below.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 未记录错误标志。请查看结果和下方的错误。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No host names or mail domains, so no records to set.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 没有主机名或邮件域，因此没有要设置的记录。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No host names yet. Add one for a paired local node, and point its DNS at this edge node.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 还没有主机名。为已配对的本地节点添加一个，并将其 DNS 指向此边缘节点。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No incident was found for ID ${incidentId}.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 未找到 ID 为 ${incidentId} 的事件。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No incidents match these filters. Change the status or service and search again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 没有事件匹配这些筛选。请更改状态或服务后再次搜索。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No local node has replicated a set here yet.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 还没有本地节点在此复制集合。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No local node is paired yet. Make a pairing code, then pair on the local node.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 还没有配对的本地节点。生成配对码，然后在本地节点上配对。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No mappings yet. Make one here, or from a file in Data › Grid with Load into…
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 还没有映射。在此创建一个，或从数据 › 表格中的文件用加载到…来创建。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: No new error groups have appeared since this release started.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 自此发布开始以来没有出现新的错误组。
